title: The "New" pill on Technician matches the Work Orders display switcher pill
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the date on your computer is before the end date of the "New" pill (07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships Technician Toggle).
  • Have the Work Orders page open in a second browser tab, showing its display switcher with its "New" pill.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open the New Staff Member window.
  2. Switch to the Work Orders browser tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A "New" pill sits at the top right of the "Technician" label, touching the end of the word.

Step 2:

  • The "New" pill on the Work Orders display switcher has the same text, colour, shape and size as the pill on the Technician label.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-R2: “A "New" pill sits at the top right of the "Technician" label, touching the end of the word. It looks the same as the pill on the Work Orders display switcher. It shows until 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships this feature, then disappears for everyone, including in a window that is already open. The moment is fixed in UTC and read from the viewer's own clock: the pill shows while that clock is before it and is gone from that moment on. The exact date is set when the release is scheduled.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "2 Turn Technician on for a staff member", picture "New Staff Member" (This build); page "5 Board View and Tech View", picture "Tech View" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p2-02-after-new-staff-member.png
  • tt-p5-04-after-tech-view.png

The design's own words:

  • “The three toggles move to one row of their own below Billable, the same row as Edit: Time Clock, Sales Representative, Technician. Nothing else moves.”
  • “Technician is last, with the "New" pill (same end date as the staff list pill). The window opens with no role and Time Clock off, so Technician starts off and grayed out.”
  • “No group for her. Same rule as Board View.”

The Work Orders display switcher's "New" pill is drawn on the Tech View picture.
